trial_court: Family Court, Shahdara, Karkardooma Court in Mt. Case No.730/2018
facts_of_case: The respondent wife claimed interim maintenance @ Rs.50,000/- per month for herself and the minor child. The petitioner husband was directed to pay interim maintenance @ Rs.10,000/- by the trial court. The respondent had already been granted interim maintenance @ Rs.7000 per month in an application filed under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming maintenance to prove their entitlement.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, the Court assessed petitioner's monthly income to be Rs.24,000/- and while considering petitioner's contention that he had the responsibility of his dependent parents and sister, divided the same into five shares and granted two shares to the respondents.

legal_principles.principle: A party's income can be assessed by considering their bank statements.
legal_principles.held: The family court took note of the bank statements of the petitioner, which reflected many entries of substantial amounts like Rs.91,533/-, Rs.27,833/-, Rs.29,425/- and Rs.28,882/- in the year 2021, which indicate that the petitioner had some other regular source of income.

outcome.final_order: The impugned order directing the petitioner to pay interim maintenance @ Rs.10,000/- was set aside.
